Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware) - Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade - Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos - Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde Segurança, governança e conformidade - Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking - Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito - Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC - Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags - Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas Automação e integração (desejável): - Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep - Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps - Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) - Runbooks operacionais padronizados Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente - Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica - title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar edisponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelasDelta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança dedados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções depipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz epropor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar comanalistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar edisponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelasDelta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança dedados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções depipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz epropor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar comanalistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:
Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental. Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25: O Grupo Capital: Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes. Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar. Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos. Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l: A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital. Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática. Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento. Responsabilidades: Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
Coletar todosos dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
Aconselhar deforma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. Pré-requisitos: Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
Proatividade orientadaa resultados;
Interesse em receber edar feedback;
Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
Experiência com vendase Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. Diferencial: Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas. Você terá: Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
Programa de partnership estruturado;
Treinamentos exclusivos;
Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
Suporte de umtime de especialistas experientes e certificados;
Flexibilidadede horário e liberdade geográfica;
Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente. Modo de contratação: Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description: We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.Js and either Golang, Node.Js, or Java experience with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology. In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products. This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent. You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments) Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity BONUS POINTS Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations) Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines WHAT YOU'LL DO Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations) Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams YOUR IMPACT Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description: We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.Js and either Golang, Node.Js, or Java experience with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology. In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products. This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed. Our client is building the AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy. Responsibilities Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements. System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability Required Experience Excellent English communication skills 8+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.Js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job) Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.G., calling APIs, integrating model outputs) Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP) Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams Desired Experience University degree or relevant industry experience Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry Additional Information Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork! Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big! You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions Work with smart and creative people Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent! We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you! 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays Start: ASAP About Velozient We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Vivência sólida em ambientes ágeis, com atuação junto a squads multidisciplinares. Experiência no segmento de saúde, healthtech, operações clínicas, sistemas médicos ou contextos correlatos. Forte compreensão de fluxos de saúde, especialmente relacionados a consultas médicas, rotina do médico, agendamentos, jornada do paciente e necessidades assistenciais. Capacidade de compreender o que o médico precisa em termos de sistema, processo e usabilidade, mesmo quando a demanda não vem totalmente estruturada. Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog. Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders. Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia. Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão. Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade. Requisitos desejáveis Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico, agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais. Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde. Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de saúde e interoperabilidade. Vivência com médicos, clínicas, hospitais, centros diagnósticos ou operações assistenciais. Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde. Conhecimento de métricas relacionadas à eficiência clínica, fluxo de atendimento, adoção e performance operacional. Competências esperadas Forte senso de dono sobre o produto Excelente capacidade de priorização Visão de negócio com foco no usuário Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável Escuta ativa e boa facilitação Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas Tomada de decisão orientada a valor e impacto Alto nível de autonomia e accountability O que esperamos de sucesso nessa posição O roadmap do produto reflita prioridades reais do negócio e da operação em saúde. Médicos e usuários clínicos percebam que o produto apoia, e não dificulta, a rotina do dia a dia. Os requisitos estejam claros o suficiente para permitir execução eficiente pelo time de tecnologia. As entregas gerem ganhos concretos de eficiência, qualidade operacional, adoção e experiência do usuário. A squad tenha clareza sobre prioridades, contexto e objetivos de negócio. Diferencial importante Buscamos alguém que não apenas conheça produto, mas que tenha sensibilidade para entender a lógica do ambiente médico, conseguindo traduzir necessidades assistenciais e operacionais em soluções digitais de alto valor.

description: We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.Js and either Golang, Node.Js, or Java experience with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology. In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products. This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed. Our client is building the AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements. System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability Required Experience Excellent English communication skills 8+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.Js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job) Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.G., calling APIs, integrating model outputs) Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP) Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams Desired Experience University degree or relevant industry experience Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry Additional Information Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. title: Product Designer
description: At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference. About The Opportunity We are looking for a Product Designer to join a fast-paced, product-driven environment focused on building innovative digital experiences in the data and financial technology space. In this role, you will design end-to-end product experiences for a platform that redefines how users interact with and manage their data. You will work on complex, first-of-their-kind solutions, translating concepts such as data ownership, privacy, and monetization into intuitive, user-friendly interfaces for both consumers and businesses. Responsibilities Own the end-to-end design process, from discovery and research to delivery and developer handoff. Conduct user research, usability testing, and validation to inform design decisions. Translate complex concepts into clear, intuitive, and accessible user experiences. Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to align vision and execution. Create and iterate on wireframes, prototypes, and user flows based on feedback and data. Contribute to and maintain a Design System across web and mobile platforms. Ensure consistency, usability, and high-quality visual design across all touchpoints. Support the creation of marketing and web assets aligned with brand guidelines. Required Qualifications Strong experience in Product Design with a portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product work. Proficiency in Figma for design, prototyping, and developer handoff. Ability to simplify complex systems and concepts into intuitive user experiences. Hands-on experience with user research, discovery, and validation methods. Experience building and evolving Design Systems in collaboration with engineering teams. Ability to work independently in high-ambiguity, fast-paced environments. Strong collaboration skills and a user-centered mindset. Experience using tools such as user journey mapping, flow diagrams, and prototyping techniques. Understanding of different levels of design fidelity, from low-fidelity concepts to production-ready designs. Advanced to Fluent level of English (mandatory). Nice To Have Skills Experience with Webflow or Framer for marketing or institutional websites. Background in AI, privacy, or data-related products. Experience designing native mobile applications (iOS and Android). Experience working on products in early-stage or product-market fit environments. Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code's consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description: We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.Js and either Golang, Node.Js, or Java experience with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology. In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products. This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed. Our client is building the AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy. Responsibilities Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements. System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability Required Experience Excellent English communication skills 8+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.Js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job) Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.G., calling APIs, integrating model outputs) Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP) Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams Desired Experience University degree or relevant industry experience Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry Additional Information Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork! Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big! You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions Work with smart and creative people Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent! We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you! 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays Start: ASAP About Velozient We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Account Executive
description: The RoleOur client is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform built for social media managers, agencies, and brands. You are the person who sends the follow-up within the hour, keeps prospects warm through a 30-day cycle, and never lets a qualified lead go cold because of a dropped ball on your end.You will work inbound leads from our SDR team and marketing channels. We will ask about this specifically. If attainment has been a struggle at any point, this is not the right fit- Exceptional discovery skills. You know how to ask questions that surface real buying motivation and you do not move to demo until you have earned it- Organized to a fault. You have a system for follow-up and you never miss a touchpoint because something slipped through the cracks- Strong written communication. Your follow-up emails are short, clear, and move the deal forward. Not essays, not templates that feel like templates- Fluency in HubSpot or comparable CRM. Pipeline hygiene is not something you need to be reminded about- Self-managed. You own your pipeline and your outcomes without needing a manager to push you- Resilient and persistent without being annoying. You know the difference between a dead deal and a deal that needs one more touchMandatory SkillsSalesEnglish CommunicationGood-to-have SkillsHubSpot

Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?Então essa é a sua chance!Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Golang/C++Resumo do Propósito da Função:Esta função oferece uma empolgante posição de desenvolvimento de software na equipe de Engenharia, uma organização multicultural com times baseados na Europa e na América do Sul, responsável por pesquisar e desenvolver soluções de hardware e software para sistemas de medição de audiência utilizados globalmente.Este profissional fará parte da equipe responsável pelos sistemas de correspondência de áudio desenvolvidos pelo IBOPE, que estão sendo implementados em diversos países. Esse sistema compara áudios coletados por dispositivos de medição dedicados com uma biblioteca de conteúdos de TV, utilizando a tecnologia proprietária de correspondência de áudio do IBOPE (técnica de fingerprinting).O IBOPE possui sistemas desenvolvidos tanto para ambientes on-premises quanto em nuvem, utilizando uma abordagem agnóstica de cloud. Sua arquitetura é composta por diversas tecnologias de ponta, como containers, Kubernetes, entre outras.Esta função envolve:Manutenção de tecnologias existentes baseadas em Linux para ambientes on-premises.Pesquisa, criação e desenvolvimento de aplicações — baseadas em charts do Kubernetes e/ou disponíveis na CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) — responsáveis por comunicação, busca otimizada em grandes volumes de dados, armazenamento de dados e mais, utilizando tecnologias e técnicas avançadas. Manutenção de pipelines. Melhoria do código por meio da adição de ferramentas para avaliação da qualidade do código.RESPONSABILIDADES:Manter tecnologias existentes implantadas em vários países. Implementar novas tecnologias para sistemas de medição de audiência com base em tecnologias existentes e novas.Pesquisar novas tecnologias para aprimorar o produto. Desenvolver novos serviços. Criar novos charts do Kubernetes.Garantir a comunicação dos containers Kubernetes dentro e fora dos clusters. Manter a tecnologia atual. REQUISITOS:Essencial:Superior completo ou cursando último ano na área de tecnologia.Experiência com Linux / bash scripting.Sólidos conhecimentos em C++ and/or GolangTDD – metodologia de testesExperiência com SQL database e NoSQL database.Inglês avançado para conversas técnicas e documentação. Desejável:JavascriptKubernetesAKSTerraformMonitoring systemsPrometheus StackMessaging (RabbitMQ)O que oferecemos?Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:Vale Refeição e AlimentaçãoHorário FlexívelModelo de trabalho remotoAssistência Médica e OdontológicaConvênio FarmáciaParticipação nos Lucros e ResultadosPrevidência PrivadaLicença Maternidade com duração de 6 mesesLicença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 diasLicença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivosConvênio com empresas parceirasPrograma de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe;
Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito maisPrograma de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atuaSe o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Implementation Analyst
description: Job Title: Implementation Analyst English Resume Only Location: Brazil Type: Full-Time Contract Setup: Fully Remote Level: Mid-Level Industry: Software SAAS Company Shift: US Hours Start Date: can start in 2 weeks after offer Equipment: Available upon request Rate: R$8,000 - R$10,000 About The Methodical Group The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.Com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge. About the Opportunity Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a SaaS platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption. The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience. Responsibilities Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients. Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations. Configure and customize the SaaS platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability. Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live. Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments. Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health. Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability. Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch. Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations. Qualifications At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise SaaS products. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles. Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams. Experience using tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms. Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously. Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle. Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills. Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Jde Cnc Consultant
description:
About Us: Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation. Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning. Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we’re able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide. About the Role: We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation. The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment. Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region. Responsibilities: The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);
Oracle ERP(JD Edwards)System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level. Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management. Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources. Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills. Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis. Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks. Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies. Qualifications & Skills: Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience. Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.G. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous) Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM) Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent. Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written. Technical competence with proven analytical skills. Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas) Systematic approach to problem resolution. Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team. Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands. Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize. Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards. Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook. What we offer: Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence. Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship. Competitive salary and benefits package. Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance. Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Sênior Node
description: About You You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.Js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions. You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior. You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.Js. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience. Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations. Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios. Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data. Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services. Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines. Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred). Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.G., SSRF). Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact. Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus). Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients. You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Take ownership of the Node.Js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase. Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations. Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance. Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness. Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment. Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments. Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes. Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms. Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes. Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability. Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes. Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development. Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in Node.Js backend development. Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects. Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL. Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations. Advanced English proficiency. Additional Information About Us We Are Engineered Different. At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: .Net/C - React (Fullstack)
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office. Quem nós somos Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia! Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas. Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa. Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact ! Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias. Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe. Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão: Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.Js, priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade. Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem, configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS. Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar : transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos. Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes). Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração. Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções. O que nós estamos procurando;
Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata. Experiência solida (+5 anos): em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.Js, JavaScript e TypeScript. Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance. Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade. Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD, uso de Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua. Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas. Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais). O que oferecemos;
VR/VT Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!) Gympass Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!) Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!) Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção) Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;
Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria! Junte-se a nós!

title: Jde Cnc Consultant
description:
About Us: Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation. Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning. Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we're able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide. About the Role: We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation. The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment. Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region. Responsibilities: The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);
Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level. Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management. Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources. Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills. Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis. Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks. Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies. Qualifications & Skills: Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience. Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.G. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous) Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM) Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent. Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written. Technical competence with proven analytical skills. Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas) Systematic approach to problem resolution. Ability to work independently under one's own initiative whilst being part of a global team. Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands. Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize. Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards. Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook. What we offer: Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence. Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship. Competitive salary and benefits package. Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance. Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: Lead Crypto Research Analyst
description: About Ideal Concept Holding (ICH) Ideal Concept Holding is a diversified investment group with a robust portfolio spanning retail, construction, real estate, and general trading across the UAE, Turkey, Azerbaijan, and Georgia. As we expand our global footprint, we are integrating digital asset strategies to optimize treasury management, explore tokenization of real-world assets (RWA), and identify high-potential Web3 investment opportunities. We combine traditional business stability with forward-looking technological innovation. Role Overview We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Lead Crypto Research Analyst to head our digital assets research initiative. Based remotely in Brazil, you will serve as the primary intelligence source for the executive team, identifying emerging trends, evaluating early-stage Web3 projects, and providing data-driven recommendations for capital allocation. This is not a trading role. It is a fundamental research position focused on due diligence, risk assessment, and strategic advisory. You will help ICH navigate the complex landscape of blockchain technology, ensuring that our exposure to digital assets is compliant, secure, and aligned with long-term corporate goals. Key Responsibilities Fundamental Research & Due Diligence: Conduct deep-dive analysis of Web3 sectors (DeFi, Infrastructure, RWA, Layer 2s, Gaming). Evaluate projects based on technology, team credibility, tokenomics, and market fit. Investment Thesis Development: Create and maintain actionable investment theses for the CIO and Board. Identify undervalued opportunities and potential risks in the crypto market. On-Chain Analytics: Utilize tools like Dune Analytics, Nansen, Etherscan, and DefiLlama to verify project metrics, track user growth, monitor whale activity, and assess network health. Tokenomics Modeling: Analyze token distribution models, vesting schedules, inflation rates, and utility mechanisms to identify sustainable projects vs. speculative pumps. Executive Reporting: Prepare concise, high-impact investment memorandums and weekly market intelligence briefings for senior leadership. Regulatory & Risk Monitoring: Stay updated on global regulatory developments (including Brazil’s CVM guidelines, MiCA in EU, and VARA in UAE) and assess their impact on ICH’s strategy. Portfolio Support: Monitor existing digital asset holdings or pilot projects, providing regular performance reports and rebalancing recommendations. Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of experience in financial research, equity analysis, or venture capital, with at least 2–3 years specifically focused on Crypto/Web3 assets. Technical Depth: Strong understanding of blockchain fundamentals (consensus mechanisms, smart contracts, DeFi primitives, ZK-proofs). Ability to read technical whitepapers and audit reports. Analytical Skills: Proficiency in financial modeling (Excel/Google Sheets) and on-chain data analysis tools (Dune, Nansen, Arkham, Glassnode). SQL or Python skills are a strong plus. Market Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the global crypto landscape, including key players, narratives (e.G., RWA, AI x Crypto), and market cycles. Communication: Exceptional written English for reporting to international executives. Portuguese is native/preferred for local coordination. Integrity: High ethical standards and attention to detail. You are skeptical by nature and rely on data, not hype. Compensation & Benefits Competitive Salary: $105,000 - $150,000 USD per year (adjusted for experience and location). Performance Bonus: Annual bonus tied to the accuracy of research insights and successful identification of opportunities. Flexible

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Diferenciais: Certificações HubSpot (Admin, Marketing, Sales, Reporting, Operations). Experiência com Operations Hub e governança de dados. Noções de integrações via API, Webhooks, Zapier/Make. Based remotely in Brazil, you will serve as the primary intelligence source for the executive team, identifying emerging trends, evaluating early-stage Web3 projects, and providing data-driven recommendations for capital allocation. Technical Depth: Strong understanding of blockchain fundamentals (consensus mechanisms, smart contracts, DeFi primitives, ZK-proofs). Ability to read technical whitepapers and audit reports. Analytical Skills: Proficiency in financial modeling (Excel/Google Sheets) and on-chain data analysis tools (Dune, Nansen, Arkham, Glassnode). SQL or Python skills are a strong plus. Market Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the global crypto landscape, including key players, narratives (e.G., RWA, AI x Crypto), and market cycles. Communication: Exceptional written English for reporting to international executives. Portuguese is native/preferred for local coordination. Integrity: High ethical standards and attention to detail. You are skeptical by nature and rely on data, not hype. Compensation & Benefits Competitive Salary: $105,000 - $150,000 USD per year (adjusted for experience and location). Performance Bonus: Annual bonus tied to the accuracy of research insights and successful identification of opportunities. Flexible

title: Lead Crypto Research Analyst
description: About Ideal Concept Holding (ICH) Ideal Concept Holding is a diversified investment group with a robust portfolio spanning retail, construction, real estate, and general trading across the UAE, Turkey, Azerbaijan, and Georgia. As we expand our global footprint, we are integrating digital asset strategies to optimize treasury management, explore tokenization of real-world assets (RWA), and identify high-potential Web3 investment opportunities. We combine traditional business stability with forward-looking technological innovation. Role Overview We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Lead Crypto Research Analyst to head our digital assets research initiative. Based remotely in Brazil, you will serve as the primary intelligence source for the executive team, identifying emerging trends, evaluating early-stage Web3 projects, and providing data-driven recommendations for capital allocation. This is not a trading role. It is a fundamental research position focused on due diligence, risk assessment, and strategic advisory. You will help ICH navigate the complex landscape of blockchain technology, ensuring that our exposure to digital assets is compliant, secure, and aligned with long-term corporate goals. Key Responsibilities Fundamental Research & Due Diligence: Conduct deep-dive analysis of Web3 sectors (DeFi, Infrastructure, RWA, Layer 2s, Gaming). Evaluate projects based on technology, team credibility, tokenomics, and market fit. Investment Thesis Development: Create and maintain actionable investment theses for the CIO and Board. Identify undervalued opportunities and potential risks in the crypto market. On-Chain Analytics: Utilize tools like Dune Analytics, Nansen, Etherscan, and DefiLlama to verify project metrics, track user growth, monitor whale activity, and assess network health. Tokenomics Modeling: Analyze token distribution models, vesting schedules, inflation rates, and utility mechanisms to identify sustainable projects vs. speculative pumps. Executive Reporting: Prepare concise, high-impact investment memorandums and weekly market intelligence briefings for senior leadership. Regulatory & Risk Monitoring: Stay updated on global regulatory developments (including Brazil’s CVM guidelines, MiCA in EU, and VARA in UAE) and assess their impact on ICH’s strategy. Portfolio Support: Monitor existing digital asset holdings or pilot projects, providing regular performance reports and rebalancing recommendations. Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of experience in financial research, equity analysis, or venture capital, with at least 2–3 years specifically focused on Crypto/Web3 assets. Technical Depth: Strong understanding of blockchain fundamentals (consensus mechanisms, smart contracts, DeFi primitives, ZK-proofs). Ability to read technical whitepapers and audit reports. Analytical Skills: Proficiency in financial modeling (Excel/Google Sheets) and on-chain data analysis tools (Dune, Nansen, Arkham, Glassnode). SQL or Python skills are a strong plus. Market Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the global crypto landscape, including key players, narratives (e.G., RWA, AI x Crypto), and market cycles. Communication: Exceptional written English for reporting to international executives. Portuguese is native/preferred for local coordination. Integrity: High ethical standards and attention to detail. You are skeptical by nature and rely on data, not hype. Compensation & Benefits Competitive Salary: $105,000 - $150,000 USD per year (adjusted for experience and location). Performance Bonus: Annual bonus tied to the accuracy of research insights and successful identification of opportunities. Flexible

title: Executivo De Vendas
description: A Caltec é uma indústria brasileira do ramo mineral, localizada em Itaperuçu-PR.
