title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‐drivenTechnical Product Ownerto serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.What You'll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key Skills Visionary Leadership:Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts:Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application:Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic. Visual Communication:Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding:Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration:Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results:Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big- Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have. Be Curious- Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action- Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together- Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Technical Lead
description:
Project Description: The Anaplan Technical Lead is an experienced multi-skilled professional with hands-on experience in Anaplan model development/Support experience. He/she is a good team player who is part of a team responsible for delivering end-to-end application development and Operations Support. Responsibilities: - Troubleshoot and provide solutions, Root Cause Analysis for incidents raised by business users/L1 team.
- Troubleshoot issues related to application access, process, scripts, etc.
- Handles Anaplan planned downtimes individually.
- In case of incident with a product quality issue, ensure PR is created and tagged against the incident before closing it.
- Perform UAT testing for projects owned by operations like new market adoption, simple logic change, etc.
- Prepare, present changes in change advisory board and own production implementation.
- Coordinate and manage discussions with other support teams and business users.
- Effectively communicate with stakeholders and business users.
- Think creatively to solve the user problem with a holistic and simple solution.
- Drive best practices within teams with respect to operations standards and guidelines.
- Ability to learn and adapt to new frameworks/technologies. Mandatory Skills Description: - Should have strong knowledge of Anaplan Connect, ALM Sync, NUX and Cloudworks.
- Anaplan Professional Model Builder / Professional Solution Architect Certified.
- Should have strong knowledge of troubleshooting and resolving incidents raised by business users and L1 Support.
- Good knowledge of troubleshooting and fixing job execution failures.
- Ability to analyse /root cause the PRs created for the Anaplan support models.
- Prior work experience in Anaplan Support projects. Availability to work in US Central Time Availability to regularly travel to St. Louis - Good communication skills. Nice-to-Have Skills Description: - Basic knowledge of Cloud Services - Knowledge in SRE, ITIL, AgileOps - Able to work independently and interact with the business community, L3 team to come up with solutions.
- Knowledge of testing tools like Playwright / Selenium.

title: Tech Lead Java
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração. Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner. Tech Lead Java Contratação CLT Estamos em busca de um Tech Lead talentoso para liderar nosso time de Apps, evoluindo nossa plataforma low-code *Miisy*. Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia e gosta de desafios, queremos conhecê-lo! Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio? Liderar o desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades na plataforma Miisy;
Coordenar e orientar aequipe de desenvolvedores, garantindo a entrega de projetos de alta qualidade Colaborar com outras equipes para alinhar as soluções técnicas com os objetivos de negócios;
Monitorar e melhorar continuamente o desempenho do sistema. Qualificações Exigidas: Experiência comprovada como Tech Lead ou em posição similar. Sólidos conhecimentos em Spring Boot, ActiveMQ, Redis, MongoDB e ElasticSearch. Habilidade para resolver problemas complexos e tomar decisões técnicas. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e liderança. Diferenciais: Experiência prévia com plataformas low-code. Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis. Capacidade de inovar e propor melhorias contínuas. Se você está pronto para um novo desafio e quer fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica e inovadora, envie sua candidatura! title: Tech Agile Sênior
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:Atuar como facilitador e agente de transformação ágil, promovendo a cultura de melhoria contínua e fortalecendo a colaboração entre os times. Seu papel será apoiar equipes multifuncionais na adoção e maturidade de práticas ágeis, além de impulsionar a eficiência dos processos e o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da organização.O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:- Capacitar e treinar pessoas em ferramentas, métodos e processos ágeis, promovendo o conhecimento contínuo e a autonomia dos times;
- Atuar como agente de mudança, questionando e provocando reflexões que fomentem o crescimento coletivo;
- Praticar escuta ativa,acolhendo e auxiliando nas questões individuais dos membros do time;
- Apoiar as squads na construção de senso de pertencimento e na busca por alta performance;
- Implementar práticas eferramentas ágeis de acordo com o contexto e maturidade dos times;
- Facilitar cerimônias ágeis, workshops de ideação, resolução de problemas e retrospectivas;
- Gerenciar métricas relacionadas à eficiência dos processos e à saúde cultural dos times;
- Estruturar processos de rotina e gestão do conhecimento para garantir a fluidez do trabalho;
- Ajudar os times na construção e condução de processos de experimentação e validação de hipóteses;
- Identificar pontos demelhoria e gargalos no dia a dia das squads, atuando de forma colaborativa para solucioná-los;
- Apoiar a estruturaçãoe reorganização de tribos, promovendo sinergia entre as equipes;
- Remover impedimentos egarantir que os times tenham um ambiente propício à entrega de valor.O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:- Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Lean, XP);
- Conhecimento em OKRs epráticas de gestão como Management 3.0;
- Técnicas de facilitação e dinâmicas colaborativas;
- Experiência em mapeamento, análise e melhoria de processos;
- Familiaridade com ferramentas de acompanhamento ágil (Jira, Confluence, Miro, etc.);
- Habilidade para atuarcom métricas de performance e cultura de times.Requisitos desejáveis:- Certificações em metodologias ágeis (CSM, PSM, KMP, ICP-ATF, etc.);
- Experiência como AgileCoach ou em ambientes com múltiplas squads;
- Vivência com escalabilidade ágil (SAFe, LeSS, Spotify model);
- Experiência em contextos de transformação digital e/ou cultural;
- Conhecimento em cultura DevOps e Design Thinking.- Desejável atuação com diferentes perfis de equipes (tecnologia, produto, negócios) e em iniciativas de mudança cultural ou estrutural.INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAISAntes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.Dito isso, oferecemos:● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;
● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
● Programa +Vantagens, amaior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;
● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
● Plano de saúde e odontológico;

● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;
● Gympass.Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc.#Ouseetransforme #sejaTOTVS

title: Senior Ai Technical Project Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career! Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment. We are looking for a Senior AI Technical Project Manager. In this role you will: Lead the end-to-end delivery of AI-powered digital initiatives across Quality and CMC operations. This role will drive cross-functional execution of AI use cases, ensuring alignment between Digital, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, and Data Science teams. The AI TPM will be responsible for translating business needs into scalable, compliant AI solutions while managing technical dependencies, governance, risk, and value realization in a regulated (GxP) environment. Lead complex AI programs from ideation through deployment and scaling. Develop and manage program roadmaps, milestones, risks, and KPIs. Coordinate cross-functional teams (Data Science, IT, Quality, Manufacturing, Vendors). Ensure alignment with enterprise digital and AI strategy. Partner with business stakeholders to define high-value AI use cases (e.G., deviations, CAPA prediction, batch analytics, document intelligence). Oversee model development lifecycle (data readiness, training, validation, deployment). Ensure AI solutions are scalable, secure, and production-ready. Governance & Compliance (GxP Focus)Embed AI governance frameworks (model validation, explainability, bias monitoring). Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, GAMP5, CSA). Drive documentation for audit readiness and inspection preparedness. Manage data integrity standards (ALCOA+). Understand system architecture (LIMS, MES, SAP, Veeva, data platforms). Manage integration dependencies across enterprise systems. Partner with cloud, cybersecurity, and infrastructure teams. Oversee vendor technical performance. Identify technical and regulatory risks early and drive mitigation. Manage change adoption within Quality and CMC functions. Develop communication plans for executive and operational stakeholders. Define measurable KPIs (cycle time reduction, deviation reduction, automation rate). Track ROI and business impact of AI initiatives. Ensure sustainable scaling of successful pilots. We have some requirements: Previous experience in Technical Program Management, Digital Transformation, or Engineering Program Delivery. Previous experience leading AI/ML or advanced analytics initiatives. Experience in regulated industries (Pharma, Biotech, Medical Devices). Strong understanding of AI/ML lifecycle and data governance. Experience working with enterprise platforms (LIMS, MES, SAP, Veeva, etc.). title: Desenvolvedor Php Sênior
description:

O profissional atuará no ciclo de desenvolvimento completo de projetos existentes e novos projetos, desde a sua conceituação (escopo, analise, entendimento), desenvolvimento, testes e implantação. Responsabilidades e atribuições: Projetar e desenvolver aplicativos Web eficientes, tanto para a execução no servidor como nos browsers, com possibilidades de instalação na nuvem;
Executar as atividades de todas as fases do ciclo do desenvolvimento e implantação dos aplicativos, usando metodologias ágeis;
Colaborar nadefiniçãoda solução técnica aos requisitos de negócio, junto a área de produtos e junto aos clientes, implementando-a de forma eficiente e eficaz;
Criar códigos bem projetados, testáveis, eficientes, seguros e aderentes às necessidades de negócio e com a arquitetura de referência corporativa;
Desenvolver garantindo a qualidade e a manutenibilidade do código, zelando por sua documentação e projetando/executando testes unitários e de integração;
Atuar como referênciatécnica para o time de desenvolvimento, atuando como replicador de conhecimento e das boas práticas corporativas. Proatividade, ética e senso de ownership para assumir responsabilidades, entregar resultados consistentes e colaborar ativamente para o sucesso do time e dos projetos. Compromisso com a qualidade, garantindo entregas consistentes e sem retrabalho, avaliando alternativas para cada situação e mantendo altos padrões mesmo sob pressão ou prazos desafiadores. Foco em resultados, garantindo entregas de alto impacto, superando desafios e agregando valor de forma consistente, mesmo em condições desafiadoras. Responsabilidades e atribuições: Graduação Completa em Engenharia de Software, Ciências da Computação, Engenharia (outras especialidades), Matemática ou Física;
Experiência avançada em desenvolvimento de aplicação Web (Web App) de alta performance;
Experiência avançada com PHP;
Experiência com frameworks de mercado (Laravel, Zend ou Symfony);
Experiência com HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JQuery, JavaScript, ReactJS;
Experiência na aplicação de arquitetura para projetos PHP e\ "design patterns\";
Experiência avançada em base de dados (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL e MongoDB);
Experiência com Github Experiência com as seguintes aplicações KeyCloak, RabittMQ Docker, DBEaver, MailHog, entre outras Experiência ambientes Linux / Apache OOP, Web Services, APIs Restfull, XML, SOA;
Sistema de Filas/Mensagerias (RabbitMQ);
Serviços em Nuvem AWS, GCP e Azure;
Experiência com qualidade de codificação e boas práticas tais como: testes unitários. Conhecimento/participação de processos ágeis de desenvolvimento com experiência em metodologia ágil Scrum, XP, Agile. Protagonismo (autodidata, assumir desafios, engajado) e capacidade de trabalho em equipes auto gerenciáveis. Uso de assistentes de IA para codificação (ex: SuperMaven, Copilot, Gemini, OpenIA, Vercel AI, Lhama, Claude);

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Professor De Espanhol
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT USSyniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLEWe are seeking a highly technical and execution‐driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.What You'll DoProduct Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP.Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior.Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKESThe Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams.The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key SkillsVisionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic.Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values:Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have.Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFERTrust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone.Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSIONAt Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Desenvolvedor Servicenow | Especialista Técnico De Aplicações
description: Descrição da Vaga (JD): O desenvolvedor ServiceNow fará parte de uma equipe já estabelecida, apoiando a implementação do módulo Application Portfolio Management (APM) do ServiceNow. O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema. Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar: ▪ Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema. ▪ Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação. ▪ Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações. ▪ Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada. ▪ Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações. ▪ Configurar e ativar o Application Portfolio Management (APM). ▪ Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação. ▪ Integrar o APM com outros módulos do ServiceNow, incluindo ITSM e SAM. ▪ Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio. ▪ Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas. ▪ Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders. ▪ Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint. ▪ Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos. Qualificações e Requisitos Qualificações essenciais - Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada - Certificação ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA) - Certificação ServiceNow Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer - Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos Competências-chave ▪ 8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI ▪ Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e JavaScript ▪ Experiência na plataforma ServiceNow como Administrador e Desenvolvedor ▪ Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB ▪ Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects ▪ Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração ServiceNow nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs ▪ Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável Outras habilidades e competências ▪ Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado ▪ Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão ▪ Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

title: Professor De Espanhol
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:

Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD, uso de Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua. Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas. VR/VT Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!) title: Desenvolvedor Servicenow | Especialista Técnico De Aplicações

O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema. Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar: ▪ Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema. ▪ Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação. ▪ Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações. ▪ Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada. ▪ Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações. ▪ Configurar e ativar o Application Portfolio Management (APM). ▪ Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação. ▪ Integrar o APM com outros módulos do ServiceNow, incluindo ITSM e SAM. ▪ Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio. ▪ Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas. ▪ Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders. ▪ Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint. ▪ Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos. title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT USSyniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLEWe are seeking a highly technical and execution‐driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.What You'll DoProduct Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP.Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior.Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKESThe Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams.The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key SkillsVisionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic.Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values:Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have.Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFERTrust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone.Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSIONAt Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Qa/Qc Manager - Data Centers

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.
