title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

description:

Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments. Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes. Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms. Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes. Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability. Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes. Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development. Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in Node.Js backend development. Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects. Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL. Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations. Advanced English proficiency. title: Professor De Espanhol
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs. Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes. Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and\ "Control Tower\" operationalmodels. Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination. Desirable Requirements Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree. Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience. Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools. Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines,regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimentoprático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimentoem Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Jde Cnc Consultant
description:
About Us: Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation. Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning. Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we’re able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide. About the Role: We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation. The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment. Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region. Responsibilities: The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);
Oracle ERP(JD Edwards)System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level. Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management. Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources. Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills. Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis. Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks. Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies. Qualifications & Skills: Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience. Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.G. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous) Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM) Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent. Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written. Technical competence with proven analytical skills. Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas) Systematic approach to problem resolution. Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team. Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands. Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize. Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards. Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook. What we offer: Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence. Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship. Competitive salary and benefits package. Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance. Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: System Architect

Proven experience architecting and shipping multiple consumer products with vision/AI. Deep understanding of imaging pipeline (sensor behavior, ISP, tuning impact). Strong embedded system architecture experience. Expert-level C++ and system-level optimization knowledge. Strong expertise in CV and ML system integration. Experience deploying optimized ML models on consumer SoCs. Experience with heterogeneous compute architectures. Experience defining system-level KPIs and validation strategies. Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills. Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

This critical role involves managing a managed service partner to deliver superior network operations and support services.Main ResponsibilitiesOversee the day-to-day network operations, including monitoring, maintenance, and incident response, to ensure high availability and performance.Oversee the escalation process, ensuring timely resolution of critical network issues and minimizing impact on business operations.Supervise routine maintenance activities, ensuring they are conducted efficiently and effectively to prevent unplanned downtime and extend the life of network assets.Lead change management processes for network operations, including planning, approval, and implementation of network changes to ensure minimal disruption and adherence to best practices.Act as the primary liaison with our managed service partner, ensuring they meet or exceed service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs).Continuously assess and improve network performance, reliability, and security, leveraging data and analytics to drive decision-making.Innovation and Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and technology enhancements, leading initiatives to implement innovative solutions.Develop and implement risk management strategies to mitigate potential network disruptions and ensure business continuity.Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, providing regular updates on network performance, issues, and improvements.Ensure compliance with relevant Orbia infrastructure standards, regulations, and security protocols to protect the organization's network infrastructure. Take care of regular audits.Knowledge and experience requieredBachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related fieldLanguage(s) and level of proficiency: English (fluent) and SpanishIn-depth knowledge of network infrastructure technologies, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and network monitoring tools.Proficiency in network protocols, such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, and MPLS.Experience with network security best practices and technologies, including VPNs, IDS/IPS, and network access control.Familiarity with cloud networking and hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.Experience with deploying, configuring, and testing network equipment.Familiarity with automation tools and scripting (e.G., Ansible, Python).Management & communication SkillsExperience in managing relationships with MSP, vendors and suppliers.Ability to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (e.G., operations, finance, senior management).Relevant ExperienceMinimum of 10 years of experience in network operations management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role overseeing global network operations.Extensive experience working with and managing relationships with managed service partners.Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent are highly desirable.ITIL certification is a plus.

title: Senior Account Executive
description: The RoleOur client is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform built for social media managers, agencies, and brands. You are the person who sends the follow-up within the hour, keeps prospects warm through a 30-day cycle, and never lets a qualified lead go cold because of a dropped ball on your end.You will work inbound leads from our SDR team and marketing channels. Prospecting and sourcing are handled upstream. Your job is to convert.What you'll do- Work exclusively with warm, SDR-qualified and inbound leads. You are not cold calling. We will ask about this specifically. If attainment has been a struggle at any point, this is not the right fit- Exceptional discovery skills. You know how to ask questions that surface real buying motivation and you do not move to demo until you have earned it- Organized to a fault. You have a system for follow-up and you never miss a touchpoint because something slipped through the cracks- Strong written communication. Your follow-up emails are short, clear, and move the deal forward. Not essays, not templates that feel like templates- Fluency in HubSpot or comparable CRM. Pipeline hygiene is not something you need to be reminded about- Self-managed. You own your pipeline and your outcomes without needing a manager to push you- Resilient and persistent without being annoying. You know the difference between a dead deal and a deal that needs one more touchMandatory SkillsSalesEnglish CommunicationGood-to-have SkillsHubSpot

description: About RateGain RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world's largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day. Exploring the role RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world's largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business. The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond. This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs) Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain's GTM strategy in LATAM Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership title: Lead Crypto Research Analyst
description: About Ideal Concept Holding (ICH) Ideal Concept Holding is a diversified investment group with a robust portfolio spanning retail, construction, real estate, and general trading across the UAE, Turkey, Azerbaijan, and Georgia. As we expand our global footprint, we are integrating digital asset strategies to optimize treasury management, explore tokenization of real-world assets (RWA), and identify high-potential Web3 investment opportunities. We combine traditional business stability with forward-looking technological innovation. Role Overview We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Lead Crypto Research Analyst to head our digital assets research initiative. Based remotely in Brazil, you will serve as the primary intelligence source for the executive team, identifying emerging trends, evaluating early-stage Web3 projects, and providing data-driven recommendations for capital allocation. This is not a trading role. It is a fundamental research position focused on due diligence, risk assessment, and strategic advisory. You will help ICH navigate the complex landscape of blockchain technology, ensuring that our exposure to digital assets is compliant, secure, and aligned with long-term corporate goals. Key Responsibilities Fundamental Research & Due Diligence: Conduct deep-dive analysis of Web3 sectors (DeFi, Infrastructure, RWA, Layer 2s, Gaming). Evaluate projects based on technology, team credibility, tokenomics, and market fit. Investment Thesis Development: Create and maintain actionable investment theses for the CIO and Board. Identify undervalued opportunities and potential risks in the crypto market. On-Chain Analytics: Utilize tools like Dune Analytics, Nansen, Etherscan, and DefiLlama to verify project metrics, track user growth, monitor whale activity, and assess network health. Tokenomics Modeling: Analyze token distribution models, vesting schedules, inflation rates, and utility mechanisms to identify sustainable projects vs. speculative pumps. Executive Reporting: Prepare concise, high-impact investment memorandums and weekly market intelligence briefings for senior leadership. Regulatory & Risk Monitoring: Stay updated on global regulatory developments (including Brazil’s CVM guidelines, MiCA in EU, and VARA in UAE) and assess their impact on ICH’s strategy. Portfolio Support: Monitor existing digital asset holdings or pilot projects, providing regular performance reports and rebalancing recommendations. Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of experience in financial research, equity analysis, or venture capital, with at least 2–3 years specifically focused on Crypto/Web3 assets. Technical Depth: Strong understanding of blockchain fundamentals (consensus mechanisms, smart contracts, DeFi primitives, ZK-proofs). Ability to read technical whitepapers and audit reports. Analytical Skills: Proficiency in financial modeling (Excel/Google Sheets) and on-chain data analysis tools (Dune, Nansen, Arkham, Glassnode). SQL or Python skills are a strong plus. Market Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the global crypto landscape, including key players, narratives (e.G., RWA, AI x Crypto), and market cycles. Communication: Exceptional written English for reporting to international executives. Portuguese is native/preferred for local coordination. Integrity: High ethical standards and attention to detail. You are skeptical by nature and rely on data, not hype. Compensation & Benefits Competitive Salary: $105,000 - $150,000 USD per year (adjusted for experience and location). Performance Bonus: Annual bonus tied to the accuracy of research insights and successful identification of opportunities. Flexible

title: Analista Hubspot
description: A Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) é líder global em serviços de TI, consultoria & soluções de negócios com uma grande rede de centros de inovação & entrega. Fomos reconhecidos como um Global Top Employer e nossa capacidade de fornecer carreiras holísticas de longo prazo baseadas em aprendizado contínuo impulsionado por nosso ecossistema de aprendizagem digital nos ajuda a desenvolver os melhores talentos! E convidamos você a fazer parte da nossa equipe! Sobre a posição: Buscamos um(a) Analista HubSpot para atuar na administração, evolução e sustentação de todo o ecossistema HubSpot — incluindo CRM, Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub e/ou Operations Hub.Se você domina CRM, automações inteligentes e melhoria contínua de processos, esta vaga pode ser perfeita para você! O profissional será peça-chave entre Marketing, Vendas, Customer Success/Atendimento e TI, garantindo que o HubSpot funcione de forma estratégica e eficiente. Responsabilidades: Gestão e Administração do HubSpot Configurar e administrar usuários, permissões, equipes e propriedades. Estruturar e manter pipelines de vendas e atendimento com SLAs e regras bem definidas. Criar e garantir boas práticas, governança e padronização do uso do CRM. Automação e Processos: Criar workflows, regras de roteamento e automações inteligentes. Implementar lead scoring, nutrição de leads e handoff entre Marketing e Vendas. Automatizar comunicações e processos de pós-venda/CS. Dados e Performance: Assegurar qualidade de dados, deduplicação e normalizações. Monitorar indicadores de funil e produtividade das equipes. Identificar gargalos e propor melhorias baseadas em dados. Relatórios e Inteligência: Construir dashboards e relatórios para Marketing, Vendas e liderança. Acompanhar métricas como CAC, MQL/SQL, conversões, receita por canal e churn/retention. Criar visões executivas recorrentes para suporte à gestão. Integrações e Evolução da Plataforma: Apoiar integrações com ferramentas como Microsoft 365, Salesforce, RD Station, WhatsApp, telefonia, ERPs e outras. Colaborar com TI/Engenharia em integrações via API e Webhooks. Documentar processos, apoiar testes e releases. Treinamento e Suporte: Treinar usuários, criar playbooks e dar suporte de 1º/2º nível. Estimular a adoção e padronização dos processos no CRM. O que buscamos: Experiência prática com HubSpot (CRM + ao menos 1 Hub). Vivência em criação de workflows, listas, pipelines e propriedades. Conhecimento de processos de funil (Marketing, Vendas ou CS). Capacidade analítica e habilidade com dashboards e métricas. Excelente comunicação e trabalho colaborativo. Diferenciais: Certificações HubSpot (Admin, Marketing, Sales, Reporting, Operations). Experiência com Operations Hub e governança de dados. Noções de integrações via API, Webhooks, Zapier/Make. Conhecimento de lead scoring, attribution, lifecycle stages e ABM. Experiência com GA4, Power BI/Looker, telefonia/WhatsApp e plataformas de mídia. Na Tata Consultancy Services promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, sempre trabalhamos pela equidade. We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow. This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries, gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments. Responsibilities Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities Serve as a primary communication liaison, screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground providers, including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized Assist with special projects, including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives Highly resourceful and high-agency, with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets), Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required) Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier What We Offer Competitive compensation commensurate with experience Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across over hours Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‐drivenTechnical Product Ownerto serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.What You'll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key Skills Visionary Leadership:Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts:Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application:Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic. Visual Communication:Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding:Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration:Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results:Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big- Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have. Be Curious- Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action- Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together- Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone. title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Overview

Já pensou em redirecionar sua carreira ou aprender uma nova profissão? Agora imagine só, poder fazer isso sendo parceiro de uma empresa que, há quase 200 anos, ajuda as pessoas a planejar um futuro financeiro mais tranquilo. Aqui na MAG, nossos corretores parceiros são chamados de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira.

E se você tem tino comercial, gosta de se relacionar com pessoas, tem perfil empreendedor e deseja trabalhar com o forte propósito de prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros, nosso Programa para Formação de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira é a oportunidade ideal para você! Sabemos bem que um processo de mudança de carreira pode ser algo difícil. Mas, participando de nosso Programa, você terá todo o suporte necessário para ser bem sucedido, desde o treinamento em sala de aula – onde aprenderá mais sobre a empresa, seu portfólio e o processo de vendas – até o acompanhamento em campo, onde realizará – com a supervisão de nossos líderes especialistas – as primeiras entrevistas de vendas.

Vantagens
  • Além de toda estrutura de suporte, treinamento e acompanhamento, poderemos apoiá-lo financeiramente na fase inicial de constituição de seu negócio, mediante o atingimento de critérios mínimos de produtividade.

  • Comissionamento vitalício sobre grande parte das coberturas comercializadas, ou seja, a comissão é do corretor pelo tempo em que o contrato do cliente estiver ativo, permitindo ganhos ilimitados.

  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.
Responsabilidades e Atribuições
  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep.

  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.
Informações Adicionais
  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio.
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam.
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social.

Sobre a MAG

Com mais de 6 milhões de clientes e cerca de R$ 475 bilhões assegurados, somos especialistas no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas em seguros de vida e planos de previdência individuais e corporativos. Em 2009, nos associamos ao Grupo Aegon, presente em mais de 20 países ao redor do mundo. Hoje, somos a terceira maior seguradora independente do Brasil e contamos com 38 unidades de vendas físicas espalhadas pelo Brasil, que servem de base para o trabalho de mais de seis mil corretores parceiros.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Já pensou em redirecionar sua carreira ou aprender uma nova profissão?

Agora imagine só, poder fazer isso sendo parceiro de uma empresa que, há quase 200 anos, ajuda as pessoas a planejar um futuro financeiro mais tranquilo. Aqui na MAG, nossos corretores parceiros são chamados de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira .

Se você tem tino comercial, gosta de se relacionar com pessoas, tem perfil empreendedor e deseja trabalhar com o forte propósito de prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros, nosso Programa para Formação de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira é a oportunidade ideal para você !

Sabemos bem que um processo de mudança de carreira pode ser algo difícil. Mas, participando de nosso Programa, você terá todo o suporte necessário para ser bem sucedido, desde o treinamento em sala de aula — onde aprenderá mais sobre a empresa, seu portfólio e o processo de vendas — até o acompanhamento em campo, onde realizará — com a supervisão de nossos líderes especialistas — as primeiras entrevistas de vendas.

Conheça as vantagens de se tornar Especialistas em Proteção Financeira parceiro da MAG Seguros:

  • Além de toda estrutura de suporte, treinamento e acompanhamento, poderemos apoiá-lo financeiramente na fase inicial de constituição de seu negócio, mediante o atingimento de critérios mínimos de produtividade.
  • Subsídios de até 70% para adquirir produtos como plano de saúde, de telefonia móvel, seguros de vida, notebook e smartphone, mediante elegibilidade ao nosso Programa de Fidelidade
  • Comissionamento vitalício sobre grande parte das coberturas comercializadas, ou seja, a comissão é do corretor pelo tempo em que o contrato do cliente estiver ativo, permitindo ganhos ilimitados.
  • Atuação presencial, com relacionamento multicanal, que pode ser realizado via unidades de vendas, telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e chat, além de portal exclusivo para corretores.
  • Campanhas de vendas periódicas, que premiam os vencedores, além do reconhecimento e distinção, com incríveis viagens de turismo ou de desenvolvimento. Acesse vida.mag.com.br/mag-365.
  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Você atuará como profissional autônomo com as seguintes atribuições:

  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep;

Após a conquista da Habilitação:

  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações;
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas;
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil;
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Aptidão para vendas;
  • Amplo círculo social (network/ rede de relacionamento);
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais;

Você se diferenciará, se possuir:

  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor;
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.
Informações adicionais

PESSOAS BEM-SUCEDIDAS NESSA PROFISSÃO:

  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio;
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam;
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social;
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho;
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais;
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais;
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.

Company Description

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

Job Description

We are looking for a Principal Genesys Cloud Professional Services Consultant to join our team and drive the delivery of innovative, enterprise-grade contact center solutions.

In this role, you will lead the design and implementation of advanced multi-channel customer experience platforms, leveraging deep expertise in Genesys Cloud and modern contact center technologies.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership, hands‑on delivery experience, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, high‑quality solutions.

Responsibilities
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders, providing expert consultancy on Genesys Cloud solutions.
  • Lead the design and delivery of end‑to‑end technical solutions, including facilitating workshops, gathering requirements, and producing technical design documentation with stakeholder sign‑off.
  • Analyze complex business and technical challenges to define scalable and effective solution architectures.
  • Own and evolve the technical architecture of Genesys solutions, introducing new technologies and best practices where appropriate.
  • Configure and optimize Genesys Cloud environments to align with changing business and operational needs.
  • Lead the planning and execution of contact center deployments, migrations, and system upgrades.
  • Act as the main escalation and coordination point for Genesys‑related matters, collaborating with internal teams and external vendors.
  • Support production readiness activities and ensure smooth transition of contact center solutions into live environments.
Qualifications
  • 5+ years of hands‑on experience supporting and optimizing large, multi‑site, complex contact center environments.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and supporting Genesys Cloud solutions in enterprise settings.
  • Proven expertise in building routing strategies and IVR workflows using Genesys Architect
  • Experience with CRM integration (e.g., Salesforce, MS Dynamics) with the Genesys Cloud environment
  • Strong background in infrastructure planning, solution design, deployment, and lifecycle management to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Solid understanding of business processes and their alignment with customer experience technologies.
  • Deep knowledge of SIP infrastructure, including SIP protocol, Session Border Controllers (SBC), and load balancing approaches.
Nice to Have
  • Knowledge of Genesys Cloud Workforce Management (WFM): provide expert guidance and best practices to optimize workforce management processes within the Genesys Cloud environment.
  • Genesys Cloud Training: conduct training sessions for various roles, including supervisors, administrators, users, and architects, to enhance their understanding and effective use of Genesys Cloud features
  • Experience with CX Cloud from Genesys and Salesforce
Additional Information

We offer:

  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team‑building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

title: Banco de Talentos Diretor(a) de Unidade - Salvador | BA
description:
Banco de Talentos Diretor(a) de Unidade - Salvador | BA

Quer ser um diretor escolar de excelência? Vem com a gente! ️

Assumir a direção de uma escola vai muito além de ocupar um cargo: é uma oportunidade única de impactar vidas e deixar um legado na educação. Aqui no Grupo Salta, oferecemos a chance de iniciar uma jornada que vai expandir ainda mais o seu potencial. Ao fazer parte do nosso time de diretores, você vai liderar uma das escolas do maior grupo de educação básica do Brasil, inspirando as vidas da sua comunidade escolar e deixando a sua marca no cenário educacional do nosso país.

Juntos, podemos construir um futuro em que a educação seja dinâmica, transformadora e fortalecida em uma cultura de excelência. Vamos transformar histórias: a sua, a nossa e a da educação de todo o Brasil.

O primeiro passo para a excelência começa aqui. Vem com a gente e faça parte desse legado! ✨

  • Gestão da equipe pedagógica e administrativa: Supervisionar e orientar as equipes pedagógicas e administrativas, promovendo o desenvolvimento profissional e garantindo o alinhamento com as metas institucionais;
  • Gestão do calendário escolar, projetos e eventos pedagógicos da escola: Garantir o cumprimento do calendário escolar, considerando excelência, qualidade técnica, comunicação e alinhamento à cultura da escola, de todos os projetos e eventos pedagógicos;
  • Atendimento aos responsáveis: Manter um canal de comunicação eficaz e acolhedor com os pais e responsáveis, garantindo o esclarecimento de dúvidas, resolução de problemas e a construção de uma relação de confiança com a comunidade escolar;
  • Desenvolvimento de equipe: Promover a formação contínua de professores e funcionários, garantindo alinhamento às metas da escola e atualização pedagógica constante, além de realizar avaliações periódicas do desempenho docente, com feedback e suporte para aprimoramento;
  • Captação e retenção de alunos: Atuar em estratégias de marketing educacional, elaborando planos de captação e fidelização de alunos, e promover uma experiência positiva para as famílias, consolidando a escola como referência de excelência na região;
  • Inovação e excelência: Incentivar a integração de tecnologia e práticas inovadoras no ensino, acompanhando tendências educacionais e implementando melhorias contínuas no currículo e na metodologia da escola.
  • Formação superior completa em Pedagogia, Educação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em gestão escolar, preferencialmente em instituições de grande porte;
  • Forte capacidade de liderança, comunicação e tomada de decisão;
  • Cursar ou ter cursado pós-graduação em Gestão Escolar é um diferencial.

Acreditamos que um time diverso é o caminho para cumprir a nossa missão de transformar vidas e o Brasil. Assim, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas que se identifiquem com grupos minorizados em todas as nossas posições.

Fique tranquilo (a) ao cadastrar seus dados na vaga. O Grupo Salta segue a LGPD – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (Lei Federal 13.709/2018), que entrou em vigor em agosto de 2020, logo, garantimos responsabilidade ao utilizar seus dados somente em nosso processo seletivo, para fins de cadastro e controle de candidatos.

CONHEÇA O GRUPO SALTA EDUCAÇÃO

Somos o maior grupo de educação básica do Brasil e temos a missão de construir um país melhor para as próximas gerações. Quer saber como fazemos isso?

Acreditamos que o ensino de qualidade pode ser um modelo sustentável para impactar crianças e jovens em todo o país. E esse desafio nos move diariamente.

Para realizar esse sonho, contamos com um time inovador e criativo, cheio de energia e, principalmente, apaixonado pelo que faz. O nosso DNA é marcado pela cultura de excelência, impacto social, desenvolvimento pessoal e espírito realizador.

Acreditamos que um time diverso é o caminho para cumprir a nossa missão de transformar vidas e, por isso, visamos a contratar talentos em igualdade de oportunidades. Também levamos a inclusão a sério, pensando em processos de reconhecimento justos e éticos, além de contarmos com grupos de afinidade racial, LGBTQIA+, de pessoas com deficiência e de gênero.

Se você quer ser impulsionado para impulsionar, o Grupo Salta é o seu lugar. Venha construir um legado de transformação conosco!

title: Agente de Prevenção de Perdas - Cajazeiras
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Vem conferir!

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Atender as normas de segurança e procedimentos administrativos da farmácia com o objetivo de zelar pelo patrimônio físico e de pessoal.
  • Fiscalizar a entrada e saída de clientes, colaboradores e produtos na farmácia.
  • Propagar com a equipe boas práticas de Prevenção de Perdas.
  • Realizar monitoramento, fiscalização de pessoas com atos suspeitos de furtos, roubos e demais delitos.
Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino médio completo.

O QUE PODE SER UM DIFERENCIAL?

Experiência em prevenção de perdas ou fiscal de loja.

Benefícios
  • Vale-refeição (de acordo com a convenção coletiva)
  • Vale-transporte
  • Plano de Saúde por elegibilidade por localidade e cargo
  • Plano Odontológico por adesão
  • Seguro de vida e Assistência Funeral
  • Plataforma de terapia online
  • Programa de Gestantes
  • Convênios Educacionais com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e dependentes
  • Universidade Corporativa Pague Menos com cursos e treinamentos - Up Farma
  • Desconto Ouro nas Farmácias Pague Menos
  • Convênio Farmácia, com desconto em folha de pagamento - Epharma

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

VEM SER GENTE QUE FAZ BEM!

Na história da Pague Menos , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Promover o acesso à saúde significa ampliar liberdade, cuidado e qualidade de vida para milhões de brasileiros. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita por gente que faz bem e que está comprometida em levar saúde com amor pra todos os brasileiros. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país e, hoje, somos quase 1.700 lojas e mais de 28 mil colaboradores que formam uma comunidade diversa que cresce junto e trabalha com impacto real na vida das pessoas.

Nossa história começou em 1981, com a abertura da primeira loja em Fortaleza (CE). Desde então, seguimos crescendo com base na valorização das pessoas, no foco no cliente, na sustentabilidade, na integridade, na superação dos resultados e na inovação em soluções de saúde. Hoje somos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil , que é fruto de uma estratégia que combina eficiência, proximidade com o cliente e fortalecimento dos nossos consultórios farmacêuticos.

Nosso modelo de negócio une produtos, serviços e cuidado contínuo. Atuamos no varejo de especialidade com o conceito de drugstore e evoluímos para um hub integrado de saúde.

Trabalhar aqui é fazer parte de um ambiente que valoriza a diversidade, incentiva a autenticidade e acredita no poder da colaboração. É um lugar para crescer, contribuir e gerar impacto todos os dias. Bora juntos?
